summary.text: David Niezgodski is a Democratic member of the Indiana Senate for District 10, which includes portions of St. Joseph County including South Bend and New Carlisle.
The caucus page lists Niezgodski as retired and the owner of Niezgodski Plumbing.

paragraphs.text: Niezgodski received the Civility Award from the Association of Retired Members of the Indiana General Assembly, according to the page.
The page says he lives in South Bend with his wife, two children, and two grandchildren.

sources.title: State Senator David Niezgodski (Indiana Senate Democrats)
